Certainly! Here’s a template for a delay notification email for a courier service. You can customize it according to your specific needs.

---

**Subject:** Important Update on Your Courier Delivery

Dear [Customer's Name],

We hope this message finds you well. We are writing to inform you that there has been a delay in the delivery of your parcel [Tracking Number/Order Number] originally scheduled for delivery on [Original Delivery Date].

We understand how important it is for you to receive your package on time, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. The delay is due to [brief explanation of the cause of the delay, e.g., adverse weather conditions, logistical issues, etc.].

We are actively working to resolve this situation and expect your package to be delivered by [New Estimated Delivery Date]. We appreciate your patience and understanding during this time.

For your convenience, you can track your package status at [Tracking Link], or reach out to our customer service team at [Customer Service Phone Number] or [Customer Service Email] if you have any questions or need further assistance.

Thank you for choosing [Your Company Name]. We value your business and strive to provide the best service possible.

Warm regards,

[Your Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Your Company Name]  
[Your Company Phone Number]  
[Your Company Email]

--- 

Feel free to adjust any details to better fit your situation!
